summary: IHG Hotels & Resorts filed a Form 6-K furnishing an admission-to-trading notice dated 28 September 2026, confirming that its wholly owned finance subsidiary IHG Finance LLC has listed two series of guaranteed notes on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange, the non-US equivalent of a US shelf takedown registration. Terms: EUR 350 million 4.000% notes due 28 September 2029 (XS3519670304) and EUR 500 million 4.625% notes due 28 September 2033 (XS3519673746), EUR 850 million aggregate, issued under a 3 September 2026 base prospectus, guaranteed by IHG, Six Continents Limited and InterContinental Hotels Limited. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch refinancing, leverage and rate exposure.
